meanings.meaning: 罢工（指工人集体停止工作以要求改善条件） verb. 打击，敲击
meanings.usage: 表示敲打或攻击的动作
busman的复数形式，指公共汽车司机

meanings.meaning: 自愿做某事（表示主动、无偿地提供服务） noun. 志愿者
专家（指在某一领域有专业技能的人） adj. 熟练的，内行的
meanings.usage: 形容在某方面很有经验

meanings.meaning: 减轻，解除（指痛苦、压力或困难的缓解） noun. 轻松，解脱
meanings.usage: 表示焦虑或担忧消除后的感觉
对他人帮助或善意的感激之情
指事物的状态或前提要求
指物理压力或心理压力
指某事涉及的范围或大小
指涉及大多数人或事物的
指双方达成的共识或合约
指向他人提供帮助或物品

meanings.meaning: 乘车，搭便车（指乘坐交通工具的旅程） verb. 骑，乘

meanings.usage: 表示通过考试、地点或时间

examples.en: The workers have decided to go on strike next week.
examples.zh: 工人们决定下周举行罢工。

examples.en: The meeting is due to begin at 9 o'clock.
To some extent, I agree with you.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的看法。

examples.en: The exam will be held in two days' time.
It was cold; even so, we went swimming.
examples.zh: 天气很冷，尽管如此我们还是去游泳了。

examples.en: So far, everything has been smooth.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，一切都很顺利。

examples.en: The government has stated that the policy will not change.
examples.zh: 政府已经声明政策不会改变。

examples.en: I want to express my gratitude to all my teachers.
examples.zh: 我想对所有老师表达我的感激之情。

examples.en: Many people object that young drivers drive too fast.
examples.zh: 许多人反对年轻人开车太快。

examples.en: The company offered free rides to all passengers during the strike.
examples.zh: 罢工期间公司向所有乘客提供免费乘车服务。

grammar.title: 将来进行时 (Future Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + will be + 动词-ing
grammar.definition: 表示将来某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作 用于描述在将来某个具体时间正在发生的动作，或询问他人的计划，语气比 will + 动词原形 更委婉

examples.en: Who will be driving the buses next week?
examples.zh: 下周谁将驾驶公共汽车？

examples.en: I will be waiting for you at the station at 8 o'clock tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天八点我会在车站等你。

examples.en: Will you be working late tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚你会工作到很晚吗？

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果 用于描述过去发生但与现在有联系的事件，常与already, yet, just, so far等连用

examples.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
examples.zh: 公交车司机已决定下周举行罢工。

examples.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time. They have not taken it yet.
examples.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试，他们还没参加。

grammar.title: be going to 表示将来
grammar.structure: 主语 + am/is/are + going to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示已经计划或决定要做的事，或根据现有迹象判断将要发生的事 表示人的主观意图、计划或打算，或根据当前情况预测将要发生的事

examples.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people.
examples.zh: 许多私家车主打算向人们提供免费乘车服务。

examples.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
examples.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has decided to + 动词原形

original.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
original.zh: 公交车司机决定下周举行罢工。

imitations.en: We have decided to travel abroad this summer.
imitations.zh: 我们决定今年夏天去国外旅行。

imitations.en: She has decided to quit her job.

original.en: Who will be driving the buses next week?
original.zh: 下周谁将驾驶公共汽车？

imitations.en: Who will be teaching us English next semester?
Who will be waiting for us at the airport?

patterns.pattern: 主语 + is/are going to + 动词原形

original.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
original.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

imitations.en: I am going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
imitations.zh: 我这个周末要去看望祖父母。

imitations.en: They are going to open a new restaurant next month.
imitations.zh: 他们下个月要开一家新餐厅。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has stated that + 从句

original.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue.
original.zh: 公交车司机已声明罢工将继续进行。

imitations.en: The manager has stated that the company will not lay off any employees.
imitations.zh: 经理已声明公司不会裁员。

imitations.en: The doctor has stated that the patient needs more rest.
imitations.zh: 医生已声明病人需要更多休息。

lines.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
lines.zh: 公共汽车司机决定下星期罢工。

lines.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday. No one knows how long it will last.
lines.zh: 罢工定于星期二开始，谁也不知道会持续多久。

lines.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
lines.zh: 司机们声称此次罢工将一直持续到就工资和工作条件问题达成全面协议的时候为止。

lines.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
lines.zh: 多数人认为此次罢工至少会持续一个星期。

lines.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work. This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent .
lines.zh: 很多私人汽车的车主正准备为乘车上班的人们提供“免费乘车”的服务，这将在某种程度上减轻对火车的压力。

lines.en: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
lines.zh: 与此同时，有一部分大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公共汽车。

lines.en: All the students are expert drivers, but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
lines.zh: 所有的学生都是开车的能手，但在驾驶公共汽车之前，他们必须通过一项专门测验。

lines.en: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
lines.zh: 学生们准备在两天后就接受测验。

lines.en: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
lines.zh: 即使这样，人们仍会感到上班有困难。

lines.en: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in letters to the Press.
lines.zh: 但到目前为止，公众已经向新闻界写信表达他们对学生们的感激之情了。

lines.en: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
lines.zh: 只有一两个人提出反对意见，说学生们会把车开得太快！

questions.q: Who will be driving the buses next week?
questions.zh: 下星期将由谁来驾驶公共汽车？
questions.a: A number of university students have volunteered to drive the buses while the strike lasts.
questions.aZh: 一些大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公共汽车。
questions.hint: 见课文第6句：Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.

questions.q: When is the strike due to begin, and how long will it last?
questions.zh: 罢工定于何时开始？预计会持续多久？
questions.a: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday. No one knows how long it will last, but most people believe it will last for at least a week.
questions.aZh: 罢工定于星期二开始。谁也不知道会持续多久，但多数人认为至少会持续一星期。
questions.hint: 见课文第2、4句：The strike is due to begin on Tuesday... / Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.

questions.q: Why are many owners of private cars going to offer 'free rides'?
questions.zh: 为什么许多私家车主准备提供“免费乘车”服务？
questions.a: Because it will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
questions.aZh: 因为这将在某种程度上减轻对火车的压力。
questions.hint: 见课文第5句：This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.

questions.q: What must the students do before they drive any of the buses?
questions.zh: 学生们在驾驶公共汽车之前必须先做什么？
questions.a: They will have to pass a special test, which they are going to take in two days' time.
questions.aZh: 他们必须先通过一项专门测验，测验将在两天后进行。
questions.hint: 见课文第7、8句：before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test... The students are going to take the test in two days' time.

questions.q: Only one or two people objected that the students will drive too fast. Do you think this is a reasonable worry?
questions.zh: 只有一两个人反对，说学生们会把车开得太快。你认为这种担忧合理吗？
questions.a: Sample: I don't think it is a serious problem. The students are expert drivers and they must pass a special test, so they are likely to drive safely. Besides, most of the public has already expressed its gratitude to them.
questions.aZh: 示例：我认为这不是个大问题。学生们都是开车能手，还须通过专门测验，因此很可能驾驶得很安全；况且大多数公众都向他们表达了感激之情。
questions.hint: 结合课文第7句（expert drivers / pass a special test）与末句的反对意见作答，言之成理即可。

translation:
公共汽车司机决定下星期罢工。
罢工定于星期二开始，谁也不知道会持续多久。
司机们声称此次罢工将一直持续到就工资和工作条件问题达成全面协议的时候为止。
多数人认为此次罢工至少会持续一个星期。
很多私人汽车的车主正准备为乘车上班的人们提供“免费乘车”的服务，这将在某种程度上减轻对火车的压力。
与此同时，有一部分大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公共汽车。
所有的学生都是开车的能手，但在驾驶公共汽车之前，他们必须通过一项专门测验。
学生们准备在两天后就接受测验。
即使这样，人们仍会感到上班有困难。
但到目前为止，公众已经向新闻界写信表达他们对学生们的感激之情了。
只有一两个人提出反对意见，说学生们会把车开得太快！
title: On Strike
subtitle: 罢工

lead.question: 下星期公共汽车司机将罢工，究竟由谁来驾驶公交车呢？
lead.warmup: 伦敦的公共汽车司机决定下星期罢工，要求就工资和工作条件达成全面协议。罢工定于星期二开始，没人知道会持续多久，多数人估计至少一星期。为缓解通勤压力，私家车主主动提供“免费乘车”，一些大学生也自愿在罢工期间驾驶公交车。他们虽是开车能手，却必须先通过一项专门测验。即使这样，人们上班仍会感到困难。
goals: 掌握 go on strike、be due to、to some extent、give in 等与罢工相关的核心短语。
理解 until 引导的时间状语从句，以及定语被谓语隔开的特殊语序。
掌握 it 作形式宾语的结构：find / think / consider it + adj. + to do。
区分 object + that 从句与 object to + 动名词的用法，并能谈论劳资纠纷话题。
lead.summary: 课文讲述公共汽车司机因工资和工作条件问题决定下周罢工。罢工定于星期二开始，预计至少持续一周。为减轻对火车的压力，许多私家车主准备为上班族提供“免费乘车”，一些大学生则自愿在罢工期间驾驶公交车。他们虽是开车能手，仍须先通过一项专门测验。即便如此，人们上班仍会有困难。公众纷纷写信向学生们致谢，只有一两人抱怨他们开得太快。
lead.tips: due to 后接不定式表示“预定”，due to + 名词才表示“由于”；object 后可直接跟 that 从句，而 object to 后只能接名词或动名词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：公共汽车司机已决定下星期罢工。
exercises.a: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
exercises.note: go on strike 举行罢工

exercises.q: 填空：The strike is due ____ begin on Tuesday.
exercises.note: be due to do 预定、预计

exercises.q: 填空：The strike will continue ____ general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
exercises.note: until 引导时间状语从句

exercises.q: 句型转换：People are going to find that it is difficult to get to work.（用 it 作形式宾语改写）
exercises.a: People are going to find it difficult to get to work.
exercises.note: find it + adj. + to do，it 为形式宾语

exercises.q: 改错：Many people object to smoke in public places.
exercises.a: Many people object to smoking in public places.

exercises.q: 句型转换：The strike began. Immediately the trains became very crowded.（用 no sooner ... than 改写）
exercises.a: No sooner had the strike begun than the trains became very crowded.
exercises.note: no sooner 后用倒装，并搭配 than

exercises.q: 汉译英：工人和学生都不肯让步。
exercises.a: Neither the workers nor the students would give in.

quiz.q: 短语 go on strike 的意思最接近：
options: stop working as a protest
go back to work as usual
ask the boss for more money
keep on working without pay
quiz.note: go on strike 意为举行罢工

quiz.q: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday. 句中 due to 表示：
options: because of
expected or scheduled to
close to
thankful for
quiz.note: be due to do 表示预定、预计

quiz.q: 下列哪句正确表达“人们会感到上班有困难”？
options: People are going to find difficult to get to work.
People are going to find it difficult to get to work.
People are going to find it difficult get to work.
People are going to feel difficult to getting to work.
quiz.note: find it + adj. + to do，it 为形式宾语

quiz.q: 课文中的 free rides 指的是什么？
options: free bus tickets
free driving lessons
free lifts offered in private cars
free car repairs
quiz.note: 私家车主为上班族提供免费搭车

quiz.q: 关于 object 的用法，哪一句是正确的？
options: A few people objected that the students would drive too fast.
A few people objected to that the students would drive too fast.
A few people objected the students would drive too fast.
A few people objected for the students driving too fast.
quiz.note: object + that 从句表示提出异议

quiz.q: 根据课文，下周将由谁驾驶公共汽车？
options: The busmen who are on strike
A number of university students
The owners of private cars
Members of the press
quiz.note: 大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公交车
